Why car insurance
got so expensive

lines.text: Car insurance jumped 58% in four years, then fell.
lines.say: Car insurance jumped fifty-eight percent in four years, then fell.

lines.text: And in 2022, US auto insurers paid out about $1.12 in claims and costs per $1 of premium.
lines.say: And in twenty twenty-two, US auto insurers paid out about one dollar and twelve cents in claims and costs per premium dollar.

lines.text: So prices chased costs: up 7.9% in 2022, 17.4% in 2023 and 17.8% in 2024.
lines.say: So prices chased costs, up about eight percent in twenty twenty-two, then over seventeen percent in both twenty twenty-three and twenty twenty-four.

lines.text: Why? Repairs got pricier. The average collision repair hit $4,818 in 2025.
lines.say: Why? Repairs got pricier. The average collision repair hit four thousand eight hundred eighteen dollars in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: Modern bumpers hide cameras and sensors, and recalibrating them averaged about $486 in 2025.
lines.say: Modern bumpers hide cameras and sensors, and recalibrating them averaged about four hundred eighty-six dollars in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: Add a record share of cars getting totaled.
lines.say: Add a record share of cars getting totaled.

lines.text: The twist: in the 12 months to August 2026, car insurance prices fell 5.1%, while repair prices rose 5.2%.
lines.say: The twist: in the twelve months to August twenty twenty-six, car insurance prices fell five point one percent, while repair prices rose five point two percent.

lines.text: Premiums follow claim costs with a lag: they jump while insurers lose money, and cool off once profits return.

post.ig:
Car insurance jumped 58% in four years, then fell.

Car insurance prices rose 58% from 2021 to 2025 (BLS CPI annual averages).
In 2022, US auto insurers paid about $1.12 in claims and costs per $1 of premium (AM Best).
The average collision repair hit $4,818 in 2025, and sensor recalibration averaged about $486 in 2025 (CCC).
In the 12 months to August 2026, car insurance prices fell 5.1% while repair prices rose 5.2% (BLS).

Sources: BLS CPI, Triple-I, AM Best, CCC Crash Course 2026.
